question_text:
Implement a high-efficiency solution for **SWE Challenge 25: Algorithmic & Architectural Problem** under `API Architecture & Distributed RPC`.

### Problem Specification:
Given input constraints, write a clean, production-ready function that satisfies optimal time and space complexity.
- Must handle edge cases (empty inputs, single element, boundary limits).
- Avoid excessive auxiliary memory allocation.
- Return correct result types.
answer_explanation: This problem evaluates optimal data structure selection and asymptotic runtime boundaries under API Architecture & Distributed RPC.

criteria.description: Passes all visible and hidden unit test cases without errors.
